clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Gazrog keeps watch over the Horde’s roads and supply lines. He calls on passing Horde travelers to face threats in the Barrens and search for lost patrols.

Gazrog watches over the Crossroads and the roads beyond it. Marauders and beasts threaten the supplies moving through this isolated settlement, so he works with its defenders to keep cargo, coin, and couriers moving. The wilderness demands constant attention, and Gazrog depends on passing travelers to answer trouble beyond the outpost’s stockades.

Gazrog’s watch extends across trails where raptors prey on travelers and quilboar clans ambush scouts. He coordinates responses to highway robberies, including the recovery of stolen Horde shipments. He also keeps track of missing soldiers, among them the grunt Dogran, who is injured and held by the quilboar.
